news.title: Suspect in custody after fatal Riverdale shooting, police say
news.summary: A man was fatally shot in Riverdale Friday night, and Clayton County Police have taken a suspect into custody. The investigation is ongoing.

news.title: Tiny fawn gets a big rescue from Roswell firefighters
news.summary: The fawn was trapped and injured in a stormwater retention area in Roswell.

news.title: Fugitive wanted in violent Clayton County tattoo shop assault captured in Minnesota
news.summary: A man wanted in connection with a violent assault at a Clayton County tattoo shop has been arrested in Minnesota, according to the Clayton County Police Department.

news.title: Large police presence in SW Atlanta
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating after a person was shot Saturday at an address on Metropolitan Parkway in southwest Atlanta.

news.title: Son of former RHOA star Kim Zolciak arrested on serious charges
news.summary: Alpharetta police confirmed that 15-year-old Kroy Biermann Jr. is being charged as an adult with aggravated sodomy and aggravated sexual battery.

news.title: Acworth Chick-fil-A stabbing: Wisconsin woman arrested for stabbing mother
news.summary: A 21-year-old Wisconsin woman faces an aggravated assault charge after allegedly stabbing her mother at least 10 times.

news.title: Police tighten Flock camera policy, one chief says
news.summary: From January through July of this year, Flock’s auditing system flagged 32 license plate searches conducted by McDonough officers.

news.title: Man sentenced for shooting Riverdale resident 13 times, prosecutors say
news.summary: A man was sentenced to life in prison after he was convicted of watching a man's Riverdale apartment for hours before shooting him 13 times, ultimately killing him.

news.title: 15-year-old son of former Falcon and Real Housewives of Atlanta star facing sex crimes charges
news.summary: TMZ first reported the case against Kroy Biermann Jr. on Friday. Record show he was arrested August 17 and has a court date on Sept. 1.

news.title: ‘She would’ve died’: Acworth officers recount saving stabbing victim at Chick-fil-A
news.summary: A woman recovered after being stabbed by her daughter outside a Chick-fil-A, thanks to quick action by off-duty police.

news.title: Atlanta Top 10 fugitive wanted in 2025 homicide arrested
news.summary: Antavious Kimber, one of the Atlanta Police Department's Top 10 Most Wanted fugitives, has been arrested.

news.title: Mother also charged with murder in death of 2-year-old in Canton
news.summary: Canton police have arrested 18-year-old Devorah Diaz Perez, the mother of a 2-year-old child who died at a home on Cartersville Street.

news.title: 21-year-old Wisconsin woman charged with stabbing mom at least 10 times in Chick-fil-A parking lot in Cherokee County
news.summary: It happened Thursday afternoon at the fast food location on Highway 92 near I-75.
